label: DX-Compass
info:
# DX-Compass

Multi-callsign DX Spot monitor with DVR-style map grid.

Connects to a DX cluster via telnet, parses spots, geolocates the reporting
station (DE), computes distance from home, records every spot to SQLite
and pushes matching spots to the frontend over WebSocket.

Frontend is served from the ./public folder (httpStatic).

name: DX Cluster Connection & Spot Processing
info:
1. Connect to DX cluster (telnet) and login with callsign.
2. Receive lines, filter 'DX de ...' spots.
3. Parse spot -> {de, freq, call, comment, time}.
4. Keep only spots where 'call' matches a monitored callsign.
5. Geolocate the spotter (de) via hamdb.org (cached).
6. Compute distance from home (haversine).
7. Extract signal / mode from comment.
8. Record to SQLite + broadcast to frontend.

name: Create spots table
func:
msg.topic = `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
    monitored_call TEXT NOT NULL,
    de TEXT NOT NULL,
    freq REAL,
    spot_call TEXT NOT NULL,
    comment TEXT,
    spot_time TEXT,
    mode TEXT,
    signal TEXT,
    snr REAL,
    lat REAL,
    lon REAL,
    distance_km REAL,
    distance_miles REAL
);`;
return msg;
